identification: Enamel (porcelain) single-sided sign, Mobiloil for Motor-Cycles, BB-D for Racing and Everyday Performance, racing motorcyclist graphic. Vacuum Oil / Mobil, about 1950s. Heavy rust and enamel loss down the left third, rust at corners and edges; right two-thirds graphic bright. Photo shows a plausible aged original (rust bleed, chips at eyelets), no obvious repro tells, but one photo only.

viewing_check: Check it is true vitreous enamel (glass-like, chipped layers, steel showing) and not screen-printed or reproduction tin; look at the back for rust and flange/eyelet wear, any maker mark (e.g. Wunderlich, Bruce Pty, Stenvet) and printing date; photograph the rider detail and the rust extent on the left.
